description: dev-pipeline hooks. SessionStart re-anchors a session on the pipeline. PreToolUse on AskUserQuestion refuses the choice card only in a project with documentation/.dev-pipeline.json: there every question is a chat message, and a card closed without a pick was read as the first option (hooks/ask-in-chat.sh says why). UserPromptSubmit, in such a project, tells the model when the user's message carries what looks like a secret, by kind and never by value (hooks/secret-in-prompt.sh). PostToolUse on edits rebuilds the progress pages and the documentation site.
